query: SELECT p.id, p.name, pv.id as variantId, pv.name as variantName, pv.retailPrice FROM products p JOIN productVariants pv ON pv.productId = p.id WHERE pv.retailPrice = 0 OR pv.retailPrice IS NULL ORDER BY p.id;
